capabilities: watch plugin main.js, styles.css, and manifest.json for changes
disable and re-enable changed plugins after a short debounce
build watch lists from .git directories or .hotreload marker files
support symlinked plugin folders for build output
reload plugins on mobile after note synchronization
disambiguation: Not a general file or note reloader; it only watches and reloads plugin folders during plugin development.
extras: README warns the plugin is for developer use only and can enable plugins that are not currently enabled in settings; mobile support is described as experimental/beta (Obsidian 1.6.7+), and it is the user's plugin's responsibility to clean up properly via onunload() and registerX() methods.
problem: Developing an Obsidian plugin normally requires manually restarting Obsidian or toggling the plugin off and on in settings after every code change.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Sync service: Enable the "Sync > Vault configuration sync, Installed community plugins" setting for Obsidian to automatically restart modified plugins
the Hot Reload Mobile plugin works with any synchronization mechanism that updates notes

summary: Developer tool that automatically disables and re-enables in-development plugins when their main.js, styles.css, or manifest.json files change.
